# LinkedIn Learning and Disprz Deep Integration Guide

## What this Document Tells You

The following steps outline the Disprz and LinkedIn Learning integration process:

[Section titled: Disprz Deep Integration Functionality](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#disprz-deep-integration-functionality)

## Disprz Deep Integration Functionality

**Authentication**: Single Sign-On (SSO)

**Content Discovery**: Automated Catalog Sync (All languages)

**Reporting**: xAPI

**Requirements**:

The **LinkedIn Learning and Disprz integration** involves the following requirements:

- An active Disprz LMS instance

- An active LinkedIn Learning account

- Admin access to LinkedIn Learning

- Admin privileges to your Disprz LMS instance


[Section titled: Integration Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#integration-overview)

## Integration Overview

[Section titled: Single Sign-On (SSO)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#single-sign-on-sso)

### Single Sign-On (SSO)

SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the
need for manual user registration. **SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords**.

We recommend SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. You can
configure SSO authentication in your **LinkedIn Learning Admin settings**. Most
organizations have a centrally-managed identity management solution like Azure
AD, Okta, or ADFS, which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise
applications like LinkedIn Learning.

To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the [LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/sso-auth/sso-docs/sso-implementation) with your organization’s IT team.

[Section titled: Automated Content Catalog Sync](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#automated-content-catalog-sync)

### Automated Content Catalog Sync

The LinkedIn Learning library contains over 20,000 courses, with 20-30 courses
added per week at no extra cost. Disprz automates this process using the
LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new
content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, Disprz will
dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures
new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of
release. All content titles and  descriptions are aggregated and indexed to
accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability. Disprz supports automatic syncing of **All languages** content libraries.

[Section titled: Reporting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#reporting)

### Reporting

LinkedIn Learning captures all content viewed on its platform in robust usage
reports accessible from the LinkedIn Learning administrative interface. In
addition to generating reports, LinkedIn Learning uses xAPI to communicate a
learner’s activity back to Disprz when the learner completes a LinkedIn Learning course. All LinkedIn Learning course completions will be reported both in LinkedIn Learning and in Disprz.

[Section titled: Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#configuration--steps-performed-in-linkedin-learning)

## Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning

To configure the Disprz deep integration on the LinkedIn Learning side, take the following steps:

[Section titled: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#provision-api-keys-for-content-catalog-sync)

### Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync

For Disprz to sync LinkedIn Learning content, you must provision API keys in LinkedIn Learning and complete the content sync on the Disprz side.

For Disprz to sync LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata, you first must provision API keys in the LinkedIn Learning admin settings.

1. After you log in, if you are not already in the **Admin** screen, select **Go to Admin**, then click **Me > Integrate**.

![Go to admin menu](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/go-to-admin.png)

![Integrate drop-down menu](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/me-integrate.png)

2. From the side navigation menu, select **Access content and reports via API** and select Generate Linkedin Learning REST API Application.

3. Click **Add application**.

![Add new API application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/rest-api-settings.png)

4. In the **Add LinkedIn Learning API application** screen, provide the name of your learning platform (e.g., "Disprz Content Sync"), as the application name.

5. Provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field. For example - "Disprz Content Catalog Sync".

6. Under **Choose keys**, there are two checkboxes – **Content** and **Report**. Select **both**.

7. Click **Next** and accept the "Terms and Conditions".

![Configure API application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/select-restapi-settings.png)

8. Copy the generated **Client Id** and **Client Secret**. Use these values later in the "Steps Performed in Disprz" section below.

![Copy Client ID and Client Secret](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/restapi-client-secret.png)


[Section titled: Configuration – Steps Performed in Disprz](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#configuration--steps-performed-in-disprz)

## Configuration – Steps Performed in Disprz

To successfully complete the integration on the Disprz side; you'll need to input the following details; which must be retrieved from your LinkedIn Learning Admin portal:

[Section titled: Required Information](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#required-information)

### Required Information

1. Client ID

2. Client Secret

3. Account ID

4. SAML Configuration Name

5. ACS URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL)

6. Entity ID


Kindly share the required configuration information with the respective Disprz implementation point of contact (SPOC) to complete the setup process. The Disprz CSM portal for configuration is on the roadmap to be built for faster onboarding.

![Get the required details from LinkedIn Learning Admin page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/mandatory-ids.png)

Note

Please note that it can take up to 24 hours for Disprz to index and make content available to learners.

[Section titled: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#enable-xapi-learner-activity-tracking-in-linkedin-learning)

### Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning

[Section titled: Configuration steps to perform in LinkedIn Learning](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz#configuration-steps-to-perform-in-linkedin-learning)

## Configuration steps to perform in LinkedIn Learning

Using the configuration details obtained from Disprz, please follow the steps below to enable and complete the LinkedIn Learning setup:

1. After you log in, if you are not already in the **Admin** screen, select **Go to Admin**, then click **Me > Integrate**.

![go to admin menu](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/go-to-admin.png)

![Integrate drop-down menu](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/me-integrate.png)

2. From the side navigation menu, select **Configure reporting integrations**.

![xAPI configure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/xapi-configure.png)

3. Expand the **Configure xAPI** section.

4. Click **Add integration**.

![Add xAPI integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/xapi-field-details.png)

5. In the **Integration name** field, enter "Disprz".

6. In the **User Type** drop down, select **Email**.

7. Copy and paste the **Auth URL**, **Tracking URL**, **Client ID** and **Client Secret** provided by Disprz into LinkedIn Learning.

8. CLick on **Course completions** and **Course progess only** as disprz do not support Learning Path Completions and Video completions.

9. Click **Enable**.


![Enable xAPI integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/media/disprz/xapi-scope-completions.png)

Congratulations! Your learners can now seamlessly access LinkedIn Learning content directly through your Disprz instance.

**Congratulations! Your learners can now seamlessly access LinkedIn Learning content direcrtly through Disprz Platform**.
